items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 34:1
items.html: For the nullification of the posterior of Aba and Ima was not due to the mixture of the judgments, which are phase four, but solely due to the refinement of the screen. Therefore they were not entirely disqualified from the phase of Atzilut, but only nullified for a time. That is, as long as they have no one to bestow upon, they remain nullified, but when the vessels return from BYA to Atzilut, they, too, return to bestow upon them as before. Hence they are only in the phase of temporary nullification, not in the phase of breaking and death, as with the seven kings. Also, the phase of the illumination of back to back of Aba and Ima reached the aforementioned posterior, called the expansion of the three lines of KHB, to the posterior standing in HGT. (p. 493, Item 14)
